amendments.A: Unknown/unresolved publisher roles do not refuse admission. An own properties.spatialExtraction member, even null or undefined, identifies derived observation authority. No role is mapped in the runtime proof.
amendments.B: Unqualified recorded context is omitted from candidate checks and counted in coverage, but the full effective set and full associations still determine the recording fingerprint. The package's own non-candidates retain the qualification gate.

design.fingerprint: commitPackage is unchanged. Its same sorted withNeighbours result, full checkAssociations result, reference, area revision, package revision and area-check-officer-v1 hash recompute the stored review fingerprint.
